The vendor directly providing **Next.js** at **nextjs.org** is **Vercel, Inc.** (commonly known as **Vercel**).

### Evidence and Provider Statement
* **Website Branding & Ownership:** The official website is titled and branded as *"Next.js by Vercel - The React Framework"*.
* **Privacy Policy:** The "Privacy Policy" link in the footer of `nextjs.org` resolves to Vercel's Privacy Notice, which explicitly defines `nextjs.org` as a Vercel property: 
  > *"Visit Vercel's websites, such as https://vercel.com, https://nextjs.org, https://turbo.build, and other Vercel affiliated websites... Access or use products or services made available by Vercel or its affiliates..."*
* **Legal Attribution & Repository:** The official open-source license and trademark documentation state: 
  > *"Copyright (c) Vercel, Inc."* and *"Next.js and related marks, designs and logos are trademarks or registered trademarks of Vercel, Inc."*
